# About this script 

This script reads in the clean dataset from data folder and then runs fits a Bayesian generalized multivariate multilevel model on the studies that report sex stratified prevalence results. This model aims to estimate sex stratified prevalence adjusted for geographic factors. 

## A warning

This script contains nearly 100 brms model calls; it takes a long time to run in full! 

# Setup

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

##### LOAD IN NECESSARY PACKAGES ##############################################
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape2)
library(here)
library(magrittr)
library(DT)
library(metafor)
library(meta)
library(brms)
library(scales)
# library(posterior)
library(tidybayes)
library(wesanderson)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

expit <- function (x) {exp(x)/(1 + exp(x))}

myPal <- c("black", "violet")

source(here("code/bacterialPositiveIndicator.R"))
source(here("code/smearPositiveIndicator.R"))
source(here("code/varianceComponentModelPR.R"))

### Set seed 
set.seed(500)

##############################################################################|
##### LOAD CLEAN DATA SET AND FILTER TO SURVEYS REPORTING SEX #################
cleanSexPRDF0 <- readRDS("data/sex-stratified-clean-data.rds")
### Calculate mean publication lag 
meanLag <- round(mean(cleanSexPRDF0$publication.year - cleanSexPRDF0$study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Bacteriologically-confirmed TB analysis 
## Format data for modeling 

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

##############################################################################|
##### CREATE A TIDY DATASET OF RELEVANT VARIABLES #############################
cleanSexPRDF <-  cleanSexPRDF0 %>% 
               filter(sex.analysis.indicator != "none") %>% 
               mutate("id" = row_number()) %>% 
    ### Scale all prevalence estimates back to decimals 
    mutate_at(vars(matches('prev100k.bacteriological.tb.|prev100k.ci.([a-z]{3})er.bacteriological.tb.|prev100k.smear.positive.tb.|prev100k.ci.([a-z]{3})er.smear.positive.tb.')),  ~ (. / 1e5)) %>%
    select(id,
           covidence.id, 
           figure.id.yr, 
           study.geography, 
           title.extracted,
           study.country,
           study.rurality, 
           WHO.region,
           screening.tests,
           participants.sputum.collected,
           bacteriological.tb.definition,
           xpert.used,
           xpert.samples,
           other.xpert.samples,
           culture.used,
           culture.samples,
           other.culture.samples,
           study.start.year, 
           study.end.year, 
           publication.year,
           study.quality.summary,
           ends_with("male"), ends_with("sex"),
           sex.analysis.indicator) %>%
    
    mutate("tempPrevMale" =  case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "adj.prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.bacteriological.tb.male, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male,
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ prev100k.bacteriological.tb.male, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.bacteriological.tb" ~ n.bacteriological.tb.male/n.participants.male, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.male/n.participants.male,
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.culture.positive.tb" ~ n.culture.positive.tb.male/n.participants.male,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male),
           "tempPrevFemale" = case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "adj.prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.bacteriological.tb.female, 
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ prev100k.bacteriological.tb.female, 
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.bacteriological.tb" ~ n.bacteriological.tb.female/n.participants.female, 
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.female/n.participants.female,
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.culture.positive.tb" ~ n.culture.positive.tb.female/n.participants.female,
                                       sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female)) %>%
    #### Create a confidence interval for those without 
    #### these are using the wilson method with continuity correction
    #### cannot seem to get case_when to work so this is going to be verbose bc deadline
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(calc.ci.lower.male = ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.bacteriological.tb",  
                                              (prop.test(n.bacteriological.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1],
                                       ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1],
                                          ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.culture.positive.tb", 
                                              (prop.test(n.culture.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1],
                                                ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)))),
            calc.ci.upper.male = ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.bacteriological.tb",  
                                              (prop.test(n.bacteriological.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2],
                                       ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2],
                                          ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.culture.positive.tb", 
                                              (prop.test(n.culture.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2],
                                                ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA)))),
           calc.ci.lower.female = ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.bacteriological.tb",  
                                              (prop.test(n.bacteriological.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1],
                                       ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1],
                                          ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.culture.positive.tb", 
                                              (prop.test(n.culture.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1],
                                                ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)))),
            calc.ci.upper.female = ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.bacteriological.tb",  
                                              (prop.test(n.bacteriological.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2],
                                       ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2],
                                          ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "n.culture.positive.tb", 
                                              (prop.test(n.culture.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2],
                                                ifelse(sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA))))) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate("stndErrMale" = case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.bacteriological.tb.male /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.bacteriological.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.bacteriological.tb.male /
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.bacteriological.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.bacteriological.tb", "n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "n.culture.positive.tb", "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                            log(calc.ci.upper.male / calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92),
           "stndErrFemale" =  case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.bacteriological.tb.female  /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.bacteriological.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.bacteriological.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.bacteriological.tb.female /
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.bacteriological.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female / 
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.bacteriological.tb", "n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "n.culture.positive.tb", "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                                        log(calc.ci.upper.female / calc.ci.lower.female)/3.92)) %>% 
    mutate(natRep = ifelse(is.na(study.geography), 
                                                       NA, 
                                                       ifelse(study.geography == "Nationally representative", 
                                                       "Yes", "No")),
                                       ## preserve the extracted study end year
                                       study.end.year.ext = study.end.year, 
                                       ## update missing study end year to be publication year - mean lag
                                       study.end.year = ifelse(!is.na(study.end.year), 
                                                               study.end.year.ext, 
                                                               publication.year - meanLag),
                                       ## Mean center year for temporal analysis
                                       year_z = study.end.year - round(mean(study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE)),

                                       bias= ifelse(grepl("Low", study.quality.summary), "Low", "Not low"),
                                       
                                       symptomScreen = ifelse(is.na(screening.tests), 
                                                                    NA, 
                                                                    ifelse(grepl("Symptom", 
                                                                    screening.tests, 
                                                                    ignore.case=TRUE), "Yes", "No")),
                                       symptomsRequired = ifelse(is.na(participants.sputum.collected) | grepl("unknown", 
                                                                                                              participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE), 
                                                                       NA, 
                                                                       ifelse(!grepl("x-ray|all participants|other",
                                                                        participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE),
                                                                 "Yes", "No")),

                                       XpertCultRequired = ifelse(is.na(bacteriological.tb.definition),
                                                                  NA, ifelse(!grepl("smear|micros|field|NTP", 
                                                                              bacteriological.tb.definition,
                                                                              ignore.case=TRUE), 
                                                                  "Yes", 
                                                                   "No")),
                                       ### Fix those that were missed with the above attempt 
                                       XpertCultRequired = ifelse(covidence.id %in% c(26989,26928,26920,26918,26892,26861,26857), 
                                                                  "Yes", XpertCultRequired), 
                                       XpertCultRequired = ifelse(covidence.id %in% c(28002), 
                                                                  "No", XpertCultRequired),
                                       #### if we used the culture positive count, then xpert culture was requried
                                       XpertCultRequired = ifelse(grepl("culture", sex.analysis.indicator), 
                                                                  "Yes", XpertCultRequired),
                                       #### if we used the smear positive prevs, then xpert culture was not requried
                                       XpertCultRequired = ifelse(grepl("smear", sex.analysis.indicator), 
                                                                  "No", XpertCultRequired),
                                       XpertCultUsed = ifelse((grepl("Yes", xpert.used) & 
                                                                 (grepl("All samples", xpert.samples) |
                                                                  !grepl("mear|NAAT", other.xpert.samples))) |
                                                                  (grepl("Yes", culture.used) & 
                                                                  grepl("All samples|Subset", culture.samples) & 
                                                                  !grepl("HIV", other.culture.samples)), 
                                                                 "Yes", "No"),
                                       WHO.region = gsub("\\(WHO\\)", "region", WHO.region))

##############################################################################|
#### Dataset for modeling #####################################################
##############################################################################|
#### Calculate the variance adjustment for non-adjusted studies
varAdjPR <- varianceAdjustPR("sex")

bactModelPRDF <- cleanSexPRDF %>%
    select(id, covidence.id, title.extracted, 
           WHO.region, study.country, study.rurality,
           publication.year, study.end.year.ext,
           study.end.year, year_z,
           natRep, bias, symptomScreen, symptomsRequired, 
           XpertCultRequired,  XpertCultUsed,
           sex.analysis.indicator, 
           n.participants.male, n.participants.female, 
           tempPrevMale, tempPrevFemale,
           stndErrMale, stndErrFemale) %>%
    # pivot_wider(names_from = Sex,
    #             values_from = c(LogOdds, LogOddsStandardError),
    #             names_sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(logPR = log(tempPrevMale / tempPrevFemale),
           unadj_logPR_se = sqrt(stndErrMale^2 + stndErrFemale^2), 
           logPR_se = ifelse(grepl("adj", sex.analysis.indicator), 
                                     unadj_logPR_se,
                                     ifelse(grepl("smear", sex.analysis.indicator),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdjPR["Smear Variance Median"]),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdjPR["Bact Variance Median"])))
)

```

## Additional descriptive output

```{r}
table(bactModelPRDF$WHO.region)

### How many persons diagnosed with bacteriologically-confirmed TB 
### Case 1: we used the reported count so simply sum 
### 38 total surveys; no missing 
### Total cases 
cleanSexPRDF %>% filter(grepl("n.", sex.analysis.indicator, fixed = TRUE)) %>% 
    mutate(diagnosedCases = case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.bacteriological.tb" ~ n.bacteriological.tb.male + n.bacteriological.tb.female, 
                                      sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.culture.positive.tb" ~ n.culture.positive.tb.male + n.culture.positive.tb.female, 
                                      sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.male + n.smear.positive.tb.female)) %>% 
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% sum() -> cases1

### Male cases 
cleanSexPRDF %>% filter(grepl("n.", sex.analysis.indicator, fixed = TRUE)) %>% 
    mutate(diagnosedCases = case_when(sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.bacteriological.tb" ~ n.bacteriological.tb.male , 
                                      sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.culture.positive.tb" ~ n.culture.positive.tb.male , 
                                      sex.analysis.indicator == 
                                          "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.male )) %>% 
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% sum() -> maleCases1

    )) %>%

    reframe(PercMale = sum(n.participants.male, 
                           na.rm=TRUE) / 
                        sum(n.participants.female,
                            n.participants.male, 
                            na.rm=TRUE)*100, .by=XpertCultUsed)

```

## Model 1: Main effect model

Pooled estimate of male-to-female ratio of bacteriologically confirmed TB prevalence. Model has study and country random effects.

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
mainEffectMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1  + (1|study.country) + (1|id),
                       data    = bactModelPRDF,
                       prior   = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept),
                                 prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       family  = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains  = 4,
                       cores   = 4,
                       iter    = 10000,
                       warmup =  2500,
                       thin    = 3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
print(summary(mainEffectMod), digits=3)
plot(mainEffectMod)

### Bayes R2
bayes_R2(mainEffectMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
nd <- bactModelPRDF %>%
      select(study.country) %>%
      unique() %>% 
      mutate(logPR_se=1)

### Adds draws from the expectation of the posterior predictive distribution
mainEffectModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = mainEffectMod,
                                 newdata=nd,
                                 re_formula = NA, 
                                 allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>% 
                    mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 

### We are interested in plotting the posterior distribution of random effects
### variance, so we will start a dataframe here and fill it for each model. 
randEffVar <- mainEffectMod %>%
              spread_draws(sd_id__Intercept,
                           sd_study.country__Intercept) %>%
              rename("Survey within country" = sd_id__Intercept,
                     "Country" = sd_study.country__Intercept) %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = c("Country", "Survey within country"),
                           names_to = "RandEff", values_to = "Variance") %>%
              mutate("Model" = "Main effect")

```

Main estimate
```{r}
### Posterior mean with 95% credible interval
mainEffectModEst %>% ungroup() %>% mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    select(mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% round(digits=2)

mainEffectMod %>% spread_draws(Intercept) %>% 
    mutate(mfRatio = exp(Intercept)) %>% mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    select(mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% round(digits=2)

### Posterior median with 95% credible interval
mainEffectModEst %>% ungroup() %>% median_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    select(mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% round(digits=2)
```

Survey-level effects


```{r}
surveyEffectModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = mainEffectMod,
                                 newdata=bactModelPRDF,
                                 re_formula = ~ 1 + (1|study.country) + (1|id), 
                                 allow_new_levels = FALSE) %>% 
                        mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                             type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 
```

## Model 2: Effect by world region model

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
regionEffectMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                              1  + (1|WHO.region) + (1|id),
                       data = bactModelPRDF,
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, 
                       warmup = 2500, 
                       thin=3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
summary(regionEffectMod)
plot(regionEffectMod)
### Bayes R2
bayes_R2(regionEffectMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
ndRegion <- bactModelPRDF %>%
            select(WHO.region) %>%
            unique() %>%
            mutate(logPR_se=1)

regionEffectModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = regionEffectMod,
                                 newdata=ndRegion,
                                 re_formula = ~ 1 + (1|WHO.region),
                                 allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>% 
                       mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 

### Add random effects variance from region model to the dataframe
randEffVar <- rbind(randEffVar,
                    regionEffectMod %>%
                    spread_draws(sd_id__Intercept,
                                 sd_WHO.region__Intercept) %>%
                    rename("Survey within region" = sd_id__Intercept,
                           "WHO region" = sd_WHO.region__Intercept) %>%
                    pivot_longer(cols = c("WHO region", "Survey within region"), 
                                 names_to = "RandEff", values_to = "Variance") %>%
                    mutate("Model" = "Region random effect")
)

## Convert random effects to a factor
randEffVar$RandEff <- factor(randEffVar$RandEff,
                              levels=c("Survey within country",
                                       "Survey within region", 
                                        "Country", "WHO region"))
```

Main estimate
```{r}
### Posterior mean with 95% credible interval
regionEffectModEst %>% group_by(WHO.region) %>% mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    select(WHO.region, mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% 
    mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=2)

### Posterior median with 95% credible interval
regionEffectModEst %>% group_by(WHO.region) %>% median_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    select(WHO.region, mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% 
    mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=2)
```

## Manuscript figure 3: Forest plot
Bring estimates from regional model together to make a forest plot for the manuscript.

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 50}

# Join survey labels
names <- cleanSexPRDF0 %>%
    mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
    select(id, figure.id.yr)

# Survey-level estimates
survey_sum <- surveyEffectModEst %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
    mutate(grouping = "survey") %>%
    left_join(names, by = "id") %>%
    left_join(bactModelPRDF %>% select(id, WHO.region), by = "id")

# Regional summaries
region_sum <- regionEffectModEst %>%
    group_by(WHO.region) %>%
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
    mutate(grouping = "regional") %>%
    rename(figure.id.yr = WHO.region)

# Global summary
global_sum <- mainEffectModEst %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
    mutate(grouping = "Overall",  
           figure.id.yr = "Overall")

# Combine all
forestDF <- bind_rows(survey_sum, region_sum, global_sum)

# Fill display label and facet group
forestDF <- forestDF %>%
    mutate(
        display_label_raw = ifelse(is.na(figure.id.yr), grouping, figure.id.yr),
        facet_group = case_when(
            grouping == "survey" ~ WHO.region,
            grouping == "regional" ~ figure.id.yr,
            grouping == "Overall" ~ "Overall"
        ), 
        type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval"
    )

# Define facet order
group_order <- c(
    "Africa region", 
    "Americas region",
    "Eastern Mediterranean region", 
    "South-East Asia region", 
    "Western Pacific region", 
    "Overall"
)

# Separate surveys and summaries
surveys_only <- forestDF %>%
    filter(grouping == "survey") %>%
    group_by(facet_group) %>%
    arrange(desc(mfRatio), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    ungroup()

summaries_only <- forestDF %>%
    filter(grouping != "survey")

# Recombine with surveys first, then summaries (preserves facet-wise order)
forestDF_plot <- bind_rows(surveys_only, summaries_only) %>%
    mutate(facet_group = factor(facet_group, levels = group_order)) %>%
    mutate(display_label =
           case_when(
        grouping == "Overall" ~ "<b>Overall</b>",
        grouping == "regional" ~ paste0("<b>", display_label_raw, "</b>"),
        TRUE ~ display_label_raw
    )) %>%
    mutate(display_label = factor(display_label, levels = rev(unique(display_label))))

# Prepare empirical data
empirical_prev_labels <- left_join(empirical_prev, survey_sum) %>%
    rename(display_label_raw = figure.id.yr) %>%
    select(display_label_raw, WHO.region, pr_empirical) %>%
    mutate(
        grouping = "survey",
        facet_group = WHO.region,
        display_label = display_label_raw
    ) %>%
    mutate(facet_group = factor(facet_group, levels = group_order),
           type = "Ratios calculated from reported prevalence")

###############################################################################
###############################################################################
forestRatio <- ggplot(forestDF_plot) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
    geom_point(data = empirical_prev_labels,
               aes(x = display_label, y = pr_empirical, color=type), alpha=0.5, size = 3) +
    geom_pointinterval(aes(x = display_label, y = mfRatio, 
                           ymin = .lower, ymax = .upper, fill=type),
                       size = 1) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_grid(facet_group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = myPal[c(2,1)]) +
    scale_y_log10(
        breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4),
        labels = c("0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4"),
    ) +
    # scale_x_discrete(labels = label_wrap(30)) + 
    labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = "Male-to-female ratio of bacteriologically-confirmed TB prevalence"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 30)  + 
    theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y= element_blank(),
          axis.text.y= element_blank(),
          axis.title.x= element_text(size=18), 
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
          axis.title.y= element_blank(), 
              strip.text.y = element_blank(),
              strip.background = element_blank(),

        legend.text = element_text(size=16), 
      legend.title=element_blank()); #forestRatio
```

## Plot posterior of random effects variance (Figure S3 and Table S13)

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 25}
                     aes(x=Variance, fill=Model), alpha = .5, color = NA,

    facet_wrap(facets = vars(RandEff)) + 
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) + 
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
    xlab("SD on logPR scale") +

randEffVar %>% group_by(Model, RandEff) %>% mean_qi() %>% 
    mutate("Mean" = round(Variance,2), 
           "95% Credible interval" = paste(round(.lower,2), "-", round(.upper,2))) %>%
    select(! c(Variance, .lower, .upper, .width, .point, .interval)) %>% 
    left_join(randEffVar %>% group_by(Model, RandEff) %>% median_qi() %>%
```

## Model 3: Effect over time 

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
timeEffectMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + year_z + (1 + year_z | study.country) + (1 | id),
                       data = bactModelPRDF,
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                               prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                               prior(exponential(2), class = sd) +
                               prior(lkj(4), class=cor),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)

### Also run this model with only those studies in the horton review
timeEffectHortMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + year_z  + (1 + year_z | study.country) + (1 | id),
                       data = bactModelPRDF %>% filter(publication.year < 2017,
                                                     id != 17, id!=72),
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                           prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                           prior(exponential(2), class = sd) +
                           prior(lkj(4), class=cor),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

### Estimated average annual percentage change (EAPC)

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

           "intercept" = (b_Intercept), 
           "time effect" = (b_year_z),
```

## Model 4: Region effect over time 

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
timeEffectRegionMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + year_z + (1 + year_z | WHO.region) + (1 | id),
                       data = bactModelPRDF,
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                           prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                           prior(exponential(2), class = sd) +
                           prior(lkj(4), class=cor),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 11, fig.width = 7.5}
summary(timeEffectRegionMod)
plot(timeEffectRegionMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
ndTimeReg <- bactModelPRDF %>%
             select(WHO.region) %>%
             distinct() %>%
             crossing(year_z = seq(min(cleanSexPRDF$year_z, na.rm = TRUE),
                                   max(cleanSexPRDF$year_z, na.rm = TRUE), 1)) %>% 
             mutate(logPR_se = 1)

timeEffectRegionModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = timeEffectRegionMod,
                                 newdata=ndTimeReg,
                                 re_formula = ~ (1 + year_z | WHO.region),
                                 allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>%
                           mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval")
```

Main estimate (Time and region model)
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Posterior mean with 95% credible interval
timeEffectRegionModEst %>%
    group_by(year_z, WHO.region) %>%
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
    mutate(Year = year_z + round(mean(cleanSexPRDF$study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE))) %>%
    select(Year, mfRatio, .lower, .upper)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
minYr <- min(timeEffectModEst$year_z)
maxYr <- max(timeEffectModEst$year_z)

eapcAltDF <- timeEffectModAlt %>% spread_draws(Intercept, 
                                         b_year_z) %>% 
    mutate("minYrEst"  = exp(Intercept + minYr * b_year_z),
           "minYr1Est" = exp(Intercept + (minYr + 1) * b_year_z),
           "maxYrEst"  = exp(Intercept + maxYr * b_year_z),
           "difference" =  minYr1Est - minYrEst,
           "annual change" = difference / minYrEst * 100, 
           "Positive" = ifelse(`annual change` > 0, "Yes", "No")) 

cbind(
### Posterior mean of the estimated average annual percentage change

    transmute(Mean = `annual change`) %>%
    mean_qi() %>%

    transmute(Median = `annual change`) %>%
    median_qi() %>% 
    select(Median, .lower,.upper)) %>% round(digits=2)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
    select(Median, .lower, .upper)) %>% 
round(digits=2)
```

### Model 14-18: Country specific estimates

Distribution of participants in each country's surveys

```{r}
bactModelPRDF %>% filter(study.country %in% c("Bangladesh", "China", "Ethiopia", 
                                            "India", "Vietnam")) %>% 
                group_by(study.country) %>%
                summarise(n.total.participants = sum(n.participants.male,
```

## Covariate analysis of male-to-female prevalence ratio

Because covariates are measured at the national-level, this analysis will be restricted to the nationally-representative surveys. 

### Setup and read in external data covariate data  
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
##############################################################################|
#### External covariates  #####################################################
##############################################################################|

covariates<- read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/covariates_1994-2023.csv")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(study.country = location_name) %>%
    filter(
           sex_name != "Both",
           metric_name == "Rate", 
           measure_name == "Prevalence") %>% 
    select(study.country, year, sex_name, cause_name, val) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(sex_name, cause_name), 
                values_from = val) %>% 
    mutate(alcohol.use.disorder = 
               scale(`Male_Alcohol use disorders` - `Female_Alcohol use disorders`), 
           # diabetes.mellitus = 
           #     scale(`Male_Diabetes mellitus` - `Female_Diabetes mellitus`), 
           # type1.diabetes.mellitus = 
           #     scale(`Male_Diabetes mellitus type 1` - `Female_Diabetes mellitus type 1`), 
           type2.diabetes.mellitus = 
               scale(`Male_Diabetes mellitus type 2` - `Female_Diabetes mellitus type 2`), 
           # nutritional.deficiencies = 
           #     scale(`Male_Nutritional deficiencies` - `Female_Nutritional deficiencies`), 
           HIV.AIDS = 
               scale(`Male_HIV/AIDS` - `Female_HIV/AIDS`), 
           # TB.incidence = 
           #     scale(Male_Tuberculosis - Female_Tuberculosis)
           ) %>% 
    select(study.country, 
           year, 
           alcohol.use.disorder, 
           # diabetes.mellitus, 
           # type1.diabetes.mellitus, 
           type2.diabetes.mellitus,
           # nutritional.deficiencies, 
           HIV.AIDS, 
           # TB.incidence
           ) %>% 
    rename(study.end.year = year)

### BMI data
bmi <- read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/IHME_GBD_2023_COV_1994_2023_ADULT_UNDERWEIGHT_33 Countries.csv")) %>% 
    rename(study.country = location_name) %>%
    select(study.country, year_id, sex, covariate_name_short, mean_value) %>% 
    group_by(year_id, study.country, sex) %>%
    summarize(val = sum(mean_value)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(sex), 
                values_from = val) %>% 
    mutate(bmi.unscaled = as.numeric(unlist(Male)) - as.numeric(unlist(Female))) %>% 
    select(study.country, 
           year_id, 
           bmi.unscaled) %>%
    rename(study.end.year = year_id)

bmi$bmi <- scale(bmi$bmi.unscaled)


### Smoking data 
smoking.prevalence <- read.csv(file=here("data/covariates/IHME_GBD_2023_COV_1994_2023_SMOKING_PREV_33 Countries.csv")) %>% 
    rename(study.country = location_name) %>%
    select(study.country, year_id, sex, covariate_name_short, mean_value) %>% 
    group_by(year_id, study.country, sex) %>%
    summarize(val = sum(mean_value)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = c(sex), 
                values_from = val) %>% 
    mutate(smoking = as.numeric(unlist(Male)) - as.numeric(unlist(Female))) %>% 
    select(study.country, 
           year_id, 
           smoking) %>%
    rename(study.end.year = year_id)

smoking.prevalence$smoking <- scale(smoking.prevalence$smoking)

### Gender development index 
GDI <- read_csv(here("data/covariates/GenderDevelopmentIndex.csv"))[,-c(2,5)] %>%
    mutate(GDI.unscaled = as.numeric(`Gender Development Index`),
           GDI = scale(GDI.unscaled)) %>% 
    select(!`Gender Development Index`) %>%
    rename(study.country = Entity, 
           study.end.year = Year)

### Rename several countries 
# GDI[which(GDI$study.country == "Eswatini (Kingdom of)"), "study.country"] <- "Eswatini"
# GDI[which(GDI$study.country == "Tanzania (United Republic of)"), "study.country"] <- "Tanzania"

### Covariates updated 
covariates <- full_join(covariates, smoking.prevalence)
covariates <- full_join(covariates, bmi)

# covariates <- full_join(covariates, GDI, by=c("study.country", "study.end.year"))

### Rename several countries 
covariates[which(covariates$study.country == "United Republic of Tanzania"), "study.country"] <- "Tanzania"
covariates[which(covariates$study.country == "Viet Nam"), "study.country"] <- "Vietnam"
covariates[which(covariates$study.country == "Lao People's Democratic Republic"), "study.country"] <- "Laos"
covariates[which(covariates$study.country == "Democratic People's Republic of Korea"), "study.country"] <- "North Korea"

### For Cambodia 2024, we need to use 2023 values so temporarily set its' study end year to 2023
newbactModelPRDF0 <- bactModelPRDF
newbactModelPRDF0[which(bactModelPRDF$id ==1), "study.end.year"] <- 2023

### For Mynamar 1994 and 2010, we need to use 2015 values so temporarily set its' study end year to 2015
newbactModelPRDF0[which(bactModelPRDF$id ==46), "study.end.year"] <- 
    newbactModelPRDF0[which(bactModelPRDF$id ==47), "study.end.year"] <- 2015

### For Ecuador 2007, we need to use 2010 values so temporarily set its' study end year to 2010
newbactModelPRDF0[which(bactModelPRDF$id ==36), "study.end.year"] <- 2010

newbactModelPRDF <- left_join(newbactModelPRDF0, covariates)

### Add GDI
newbactModelPRDF <- left_join(newbactModelPRDF, GDI)
```

### Covariate correlation assessment
Estimate the correlation between the covariate data using a BRMS multivariate model with fixed intercepts and sigmas. Approach inspired by this post 
https://solomonkurz.netlify.app/blog/2019-02-16-bayesian-correlations-let-s-talk-options/

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
### Rename the columns so they present well in plot
### Use "Z" as a space delimiter as model run will strip "_" or "." 
formatbactModelPRDF <- newbactModelPRDF %>% 
                     filter(natRep == "Yes") %>%
                     rename("StudyZendZyear" = year_z, 
                            "AlcoholZuseZdisorder" = alcohol.use.disorder, 
                            "TypeZ2ZDiabetesZMellitus" = type2.diabetes.mellitus, 
                            "LowZBMI" = bmi, 
                            "HIVZAIDS" = HIV.AIDS, 
                            "GenderZdevelopmentZindex" = GDI, 
                            "Smoking" = smoking)

covCorrMod <-  brms::brm(bf(mvbind(`AlcoholZuseZdisorder`,
                                   `GenderZdevelopmentZindex`,
                                   `HIVZAIDS`, 
                                   `LowZBMI`, 
                                   `Smoking`, 
                                   `TypeZ2ZDiabetesZMellitus`, 
                                   `StudyZendZyear`) ~ 0,
                         sigma ~ 0) + 
                         set_rescor(TRUE), 
                         data    = formatbactModelPRDF,
                         prior   = prior(lkj(2), class = rescor),
                         family  = gaussian(),
                         control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                         chains  = 4,
                         cores   = 4,
                         iter    = 15000, thin=3)

# summary(covCorrMod)

    as_draws_df(covCorrMod) %>% 
    select(starts_with("rescor")) %>% 
    gather(label, rho) %>% 
    select(rho, label) %>% 
    mutate(label = gsub("Z", " ", gsub("__", " with\n", gsub("rescor__", "", label)))) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = rho, y = label)) +
    stat_halfeye(.width = .95, size = 5/4) + theme_minimal(base_size = 16) + 
    ylab("") + 
    ggtitle("Estimated correlation of covariates") + 
    expand_limits(x=c(-1,1))

    as_draws_df(covCorrMod) %>% 
    select(starts_with("rescor")) %>% 
    gather(label, rho) %>% 
    select(rho, label) %>% 
    mutate(label = gsub("Z", " ", gsub("__", " with ", gsub("rescor__", "", label)))) %>% 
    group_by(label) %>% 
    mean_qi(rho) #%>% View()

```

### Model 28: Study end year univariate model 
Note this is different from model 3 above as it is only fit to nationally-representative surveys 

Model specification 

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
timeMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + study.end.year + 
                          (1 | study.country) + (1 | id),
                       data = newbactModelPRDF  %>% 
                              filter(natRep == "Yes"),
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                           prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                           prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
bayes_R2(timeMod)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
    select(Mean) %>% 
    mean_qi() %>%

timeMod %>% spread_draws(b_study.end.year) %>% mutate(Median = exp(b_study.end.year)) %>% 
    select(Median) %>% 
    median_qi() %>% 
    select(Median, .lower, .upper)) %>% round(2)
```

#### Country-level estimates 

```{r}
ndMulti <- newbactModelPRDF %>%
           select(study.country, year_z, GDI, 
                  type2.diabetes.mellitus, alcohol.use.disorder, 
                  bmi, HIV.AIDS, smoking) %>%
           na.omit() %>%
           unique() %>% 
           mutate(logPR_se=1)

### Adds draws from the expectation of the posterior predictive distribution
multiModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = multiMod,
                                 newdata=ndMulti,
                                 re_formula = ~ 1 + (1|study.country), 
                                 allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>% 
                    mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 

### Posterior mean
multiMean <- multiModEst %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(study.country) %>%
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% 
    mutate(Mean=round(mfRatio,2), 
           Interval = paste(round(.lower,2), "-", round(.upper,2))) %>%
    select(study.country, Mean, Interval) 

### Posterior median
multiMedian <- multiModEst %>% ungroup() %>%
        group_by(study.country) %>%
    median_qi(mfRatio)  %>% 
    mutate(Median=round(mfRatio,2)) %>% 
    select(Median)

multiCountryEsts <- data.frame(study.country = multiMean$study.country, 
                               "Posterior mean" = multiMean$Mean,
                               "Posterior median" = multiMedian$Median,
                               "95% credible interval" = multiMean$Interval)

write.csv(multiCountryEsts, here("output/SEX/multivariableModelCountryEstimates.csv"))
```

# Smear positive analysis 

## Format data for modeling

```{r, echo = FALSE,  warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}

cleanSexSmrDF0 <- smrPosIndicator("sex") %>% filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator !="none")

##############################################################################|
##### CREATE A TIDY DATASET OF RELEVANT VARIABLES #############################
cleanSexSmrDF <- cleanSexSmrDF0 %>% 
                 filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator != "none") %>% 
                 mutate("id" = row_number(),
                        ### We have a lower ci of zero so replace with super small non-zero number
                        adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female = ifelse(
                                            adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female == 0, 
                                            1e-4, 
                                            adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female
                        )) %>%
                 ### Scale all prevalence estimates back to decimals 
                 mutate_at(vars(matches('prev100k.smear.positive.tb.|prev100k.ci.([a-z]{3})er.smear.positive.tb.')),  ~ (. / 1e5)) %>% 
                 select(id,
                       covidence.id, 
                       figure.id.yr, 
                       study.geography, 
                       title.extracted,
                       study.country,
                       WHO.region,
                       study.start.year, 
                       study.end.year, 
                       publication.year,
                       study.quality.summary,
                       screening.tests,
                       bacteriological.tb.definition, 
                       xpert.samples, xpert.used, other.xpert.samples,
                       culture.samples, culture.used, other.culture.samples,
                       participants.sputum.collected,
                       ends_with("male"), ends_with("sex"),
                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator) %>%
    
    mutate("tempPrevMale" =  case_when(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male,
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male, 
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.male/n.participants.male,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male),
           "tempPrevFemale" = case_when(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                            "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female, 
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "n.smear.positive.tb" ~ n.smear.positive.tb.female/n.participants.female,
                                       sex.smr.analysis.indicator == 
                                           "prev100k.smear.positive.tb" ~ prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female)) %>%

    #### Create a confidence interval for those without 
    #### these are using the wilson method with continuity correction
    #### cannot seem to get case_when to work so this is going to be verbose bc deadline
    
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(calc.ci.lower.male = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1],
                                        ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)),
            calc.ci.upper.male = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                        (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2],
                                  ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male*n.participants.male, n.participants.male))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA)),
           calc.ci.lower.female = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1],
                                  ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[1], 
                                              NA)),
            calc.ci.upper.female = ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(n.smear.positive.tb.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2],
                                   ifelse(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.smear.positive.tb",
                                              (prop.test(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female*n.participants.female, n.participants.female))$conf.int[2], 
                                              NA))) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate("stndErrMale" = case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.male /
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.male)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                            log(calc.ci.upper.male / calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92),
           "stndErrFemale" =  case_when(
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "adj.prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb"  ~ 
                                         log(adj.prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female /
                                                                 adj.prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,

                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb" ~ 
                                            log(prev100k.ci.upper.smear.positive.tb.female / 
                                                                 prev100k.ci.lower.smear.positive.tb.female)/3.92,
                                        sex.smr.analysis.indicator %in% c("n.smear.positive.tb", 
                                                                      "prev100k.smear.positive.tb")  ~ 
                                                        log(calc.ci.upper.male / calc.ci.lower.male)/3.92)) %>% 
                                mutate(natRep = ifelse(is.na(study.geography), 
                                                       NA, 
                                                       ifelse(study.geography == "Nationally representative", 
                                                       "Yes", "No")),
                                       ## preserve the extracted study end year
                                       study.end.year.ext = study.end.year, 
                                       ## update missing study end year to be publication year - mean lag
                                       study.end.year = ifelse(!is.na(study.end.year), 
                                                               study.end.year.ext, 
                                                               publication.year - meanLag),
                                       ## Mean center year for temporal analysis
                                       year_z = study.end.year - round(mean(study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE)),

                                       bias= ifelse(grepl("Low", study.quality.summary), "Low", "Not low"),
                                       
                                       symptomScreen = ifelse(is.na(screening.tests), 
                                                                    NA, 
                                                                    ifelse(grepl("Symptom", 
                                                                    screening.tests, 
                                                                    ignore.case=TRUE), "Yes", "No")),
                                       symptomsRequired = ifelse(is.na(participants.sputum.collected) | grepl("unknown", 
                                                                                                              participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE), 
                                                                       NA, 
                                                                       ifelse(!grepl("x-ray|all participants|other",
                                                                        participants.sputum.collected,ignore.case=TRUE),
                                                                 "Yes", "No")),

                                       WHO.region = gsub("\\(WHO\\)", "region", WHO.region))

##############################################################################|
#### Dataset for modeling #####################################################
##############################################################################|
#### Calculate the variance adjustment for non-adjusted studies
varAdjPR <- varianceAdjustPR("sex")


smrModelDF <- cleanSexSmrDF %>%
    select(id,covidence.id, WHO.region, study.country, year_z, natRep, 
           symptomsRequired,
           n.participants.male, n.participants.female,
           tempPrevMale, tempPrevFemale,
           stndErrMale, stndErrFemale,
           sex.smr.analysis.indicator) %>%

    mutate(logPR = log(tempPrevMale / tempPrevFemale),
           unadj_logPR_se = sqrt(stndErrMale^2 + stndErrFemale^2), 
           logPR_se = ifelse(grepl("adj", sex.smr.analysis.indicator), 
                                     unadj_logPR_se,
                                     ifelse(grepl("smear", sex.smr.analysis.indicator),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdjPR["Smear Variance Median"]),
                                         sqrt(`unadj_logPR_se`^2 + varAdjPR["Bact Variance Median"])))
)

```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
print(paste(dim(cleanSexSmrDF0)[1], "unique surveys with sex-stratified smear positive TB"))

### How many persons diagnosed with bacteriologically-confirmed TB 
### Case 1: we used the reported count so simply sum 
### 27 total surveys; no missing 
cleanSexSmrDF %>% filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb") %>% 
    mutate(diagnosedCases = n.smear.positive.tb.male + n.smear.positive.tb.female) %>% 
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% sum() -> smrCases1

## Among males only
cleanSexSmrDF %>% filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator == "n.smear.positive.tb") %>% 
    mutate(diagnosedCases = n.smear.positive.tb.male) %>% 
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% sum() -> smrMaleCases1

### Case 2: we used smear positive prevalence risk so pull their reported 
### counts (if available) or we need participant counts. 
### 37 total surveys; 27 reported case counts; 10 estimated; 0 missing 
cleanSexSmrDF %>% filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator != "n.smear.positive.tb") %>%
    mutate(diagnosedCases = case_when(!is.na(n.smear.positive.tb.male) ~
                                           n.smear.positive.tb.male + n.smear.positive.tb.female,
                                       !is.na(n.participants.male)  & !is.na(adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male) ~
                                           adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male * n.participants.male +
                                           adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female * n.participants.female,
                                       !is.na(n.participants.male)  & !is.na(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male) ~
                                           prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male * n.participants.male +
                                           prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female * n.participants.female
    )) %>%
#     select(sex.smr.analysis.indicator,
#            n.smear.positive.tb.female,
#            n.smear.positive.tb.male,
#            adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female,
#            adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male,
#            prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb.female,
#            prev100k.ci.smear.positive.tb.male,
#            prev100k.smear.positive.tb.female,
#            prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male,
#            n.participants.female,
#            n.participants.male,
#            diagnosedCases) %>% View()
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% round() %>% sum(na.rm = TRUE) -> smrCases2

## Among males only
cleanSexSmrDF %>% filter(sex.smr.analysis.indicator != "n.smear.positive.tb") %>%
    mutate(diagnosedCases = case_when(!is.na(n.smear.positive.tb.male) ~ 
                                           n.smear.positive.tb.male, 
                                       !is.na(n.participants.male)  & !is.na(adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male) ~
                                           adj.prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male * n.participants.male,
                                       !is.na(n.participants.male)  & !is.na(prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male) ~
                                           prev100k.smear.positive.tb.male * n.participants.male
                                           
    )) %>% 
    select(diagnosedCases) %>% round() %>% sum(na.rm = TRUE) -> smrMaleCases2
```

## Model 36: Smear positive main effect 

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
mainEffectSmrMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1  + (1 | study.country) + (1|id),
                       data = smrModelDF,
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                                     prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
summary(mainEffectSmrMod)
plot(mainEffectSmrMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
nd <- smrModelDF %>%
      select(study.country, tempPrevFemale) %>%
      mutate(logPR_se=1)

mainEffectSmrModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = mainEffectSmrMod,
                                 newdata=nd,
                                 re_formula = ~ 1) %>% 
                    mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 
```

Main estimate
```{r}
mainEffectSmrModEst %>% ungroup %>% mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% select(mfRatio, .lower, .upper) %>% round(digits=2)
```

## Model 37: Smear positive effect by world region model

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
regionEffectSmrMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1  + (1|WHO.region) + (1|id),
                       data = smrModelDF,
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                                prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
summary(regionEffectSmrMod)
plot(regionEffectSmrMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
ndRegion <- smrModelDF %>%
            select(WHO.region, tempPrevFemale) %>%
            mutate(logPR_se=1)

regionEffectSmrModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = regionEffectSmrMod,
                                 newdata=ndRegion,
                                 re_formula = ~ 1 + (1|WHO.region)) %>% 
                       mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval") 
```

Main estimate
```{r, message=FALSE}
regionEffectSmrModEst %>% group_by(WHO.region) %>% 
    mean_qi(mfRatio) %>% select(WHO.region, mfRatio)  %>% 
    rename(Mean = mfRatio) %>%
    left_join(
        regionEffectSmrModEst %>% group_by(WHO.region) %>% 
        rename(Median = mfRatio) %>%
        median_qi(Median) %>% select(WHO.region, Median, .lower, .upper)   
    ) %>%
    mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=2)
```

# Some comparisons between smear-positive and bacteriologically-confirmed TB 

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Reviewer noted that while some of the WHO regions had extremely similar MF ratios for smr vs. bc, others had larger differences. Is there any reason we can see in the data to explain this? 

### Small difference: South East Asia Region
### Relatively large difference: Africa Region

### Is there a difference in the percentage of smear positive used as bacteriologically positive between the two regions? 
### South East Asia Region
nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", grepl("smear", sex.analysis.indicator))) / 
    nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

### Africa Region
nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "Africa region", grepl("smear", sex.analysis.indicator))) / 
    nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

### Consider effect sizes in a moment

## South East Asia Region
nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", symptomsRequired == "Yes")) / 
    nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

nrow(smrModelDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", symptomsRequired == "Yes")) / 
    nrow(smrModelDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

### Africa Region
nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "Africa region",  symptomsRequired == "Yes")) / 
    nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

nrow(smrModelDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "Africa region",  symptomsRequired == "Yes")) / 
    nrow(smrModelDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region")) * 100

### Do we see differences in symptoms required?

nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", XpertCultRequired == "Yes")) /

nrow(bactModelPRDF %>% filter(WHO.region == "Africa region",  XpertCultRequired == "Yes")) /

### Some difference -- what about effect sizes?
bactModelPRDF %>% 
    filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", XpertCultRequired == "Yes") %>% 
    mutate(MFRatio = exp(logPR)) %>% 
    select(MFRatio) %>% mean()

bactModelPRDF %>% 
    filter(WHO.region == "South-East Asia region", XpertCultRequired == "No") %>% 
    mutate(MFRatio = exp(logPR)) %>% 
    select(MFRatio) %>% mean()

bactModelPRDF %>% 
    filter(WHO.region == "Africa region", XpertCultRequired == "Yes") %>% 
    mutate(MFRatio = exp(logPR)) %>% 
    select(MFRatio) %>% mean()

    filter(WHO.region == "Africa region", XpertCultRequired == "No") %>%
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
cntryRegMainMod<- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 +  (1 | WHO.region/study.country) + (1 | id),
```

### Estimated average annual percentage change (EAPC) and covariate effect

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Set the min and max years just for clarity
minYr <- min(timeEffectSympReqModEst$year_z)
maxYr <- max(timeEffectSympReqModEst$year_z)


eapcSympReqDF0 <- timeEffectSympReqMod0 %>% 
                 spread_draws(b_Intercept,

    mutate(
           # "minYrEst"  = exp(b_ntercept + minYr * b_year_z),
           # "minYr1Est" = exp(b_Intercept + (minYr + 1) * b_year_z),
           # "maxYrEst"  = exp(b_Intercept + maxYr * b_year_z),

           # "Positive" = ifelse(`annual change` > 0, "Yes", "No"), 
           "annual change" = exp(b_year_z)-1,
           "intercept" = (b_Intercept), 
           "time effect" = (b_year_z),
           "covariate effect" = (b_symptomsRequiredYes)) 
rbind(
```

## Model 48: Effect over time with "Symptoms Required" as a covariate (with interaction)

Model specification
```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, results="hide"}
timeEffectSympReqMod <- brms::brm(formula = logPR | se(logPR_se, sigma=TRUE) ~ 
                           1 + symptomsRequired*year_z + 
                          (1 + symptomsRequired*year_z | study.country) + 
                          (1 | id),
                       data = bactModelPRDF, 
                       prior = prior(student_t(7, 0, 1.5), class = Intercept) +
                               prior(normal(0, 1), class = b) +
                               prior(exponential(2), class = sd) +
                               prior(lkj(4), class=cor),
                       family = gaussian(),
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99),
                       chains = 4,
                       cores = 4,
                       iter = 10000, warmup = 2500, thin=3)
```

Summarize and check 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height = 20, fig.width = 28}
summary(timeEffectSympReqMod)
plot(timeEffectSympReqMod)
```

Prediction

```{r, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
ndSympReqTime <- bactModelPRDF %>%
                    select(logPR_se) %>%
                    crossing(year_z = seq(min(cleanSexPRDF$year_z, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                        max(cleanSexPRDF$year_z, na.rm = TRUE), 1), 
                                       symptomsRequired = c("Yes", "No")) %>%
                  mutate(logPR_se = 1)

timeEffectSympReqModEst <- add_epred_draws(object = timeEffectSympReqMod,
                             newdata=ndSympReqTime,
                                 re_formula = NA,
                                 allow_new_levels = TRUE) %>%
                           mutate(mfRatio = exp(.epred),
                           type="Posterior mean and 95% credible interval")


```

Main estimate
```{r}
ySympReq <-  timeEffectSympReqModEst %>%
             filter(symptomsRequired == "Yes") %>%
             group_by(year_z) %>%
             mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
             mutate(Year = year_z + round(mean(cleanSexPRDF$study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE)), 
                            Mean = round(mfRatio, 2) )

ySympNoReq <- timeEffectSympReqModEst %>%
             filter(symptomsRequired == "No") %>%
             group_by(year_z) %>%
             mean_qi(mfRatio) %>%
             mutate(Year = year_z + round(mean(cleanSexPRDF$study.end.year, na.rm=TRUE)), 
                            Mean = round(mfRatio, 2) )
```

### Estimated average annual percentage change (EAPC) and covariate effect

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
### Set the min and max years just for clarity
minYr <- min(timeEffectSympReqModEst$year_z)
maxYr <- max(timeEffectSympReqModEst$year_z)


eapcSympReqDF <- timeEffectSympReqMod %>% 
                 spread_draws(b_Intercept, 
                              b_year_z, 
                              b_symptomsRequiredYes, 
                             `b_symptomsRequiredYes:year_z`) %>% 
    mutate(
           # "minYrEst"  = exp(b_ntercept + minYr * b_year_z),
           # "minYr1Est" = exp(b_Intercept + (minYr + 1) * b_year_z),
           # "maxYrEst"  = exp(b_Intercept + maxYr * b_year_z),
           # "difference" =  minYr1Est - minYrEst,
           # "annual change" = difference / minYrEst * 100, 
           # "Positive" = ifelse(`annual change` > 0, "Yes", "No"), 
           "annual change" = exp(b_year_z)-1,
           "intercept" = exp(b_Intercept), 
           "time effect" = exp(b_year_z),
           "covariate effect" = exp(b_symptomsRequiredYes), 
           "covariate interaction" = exp(`b_symptomsRequiredYes:year_z`)) 
rbind(
### Posterior mean of the estimated average annual percentage change
eapcSympReqDF %>%
    select(`annual change`, `intercept`, `time effect`,
           `covariate effect`, `covariate interaction`) %>%
    mean_qi(),
### Posterior median of the estimated average annual percentage change
eapcSympReqDF %>%
    select(`annual change`, `intercept`, `time effect`,
           `covariate effect`, `covariate interaction`) %>%
    median_qi()) %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits=2)
```

```{r}
allTemporalMods <- rbind(
        eapcDF %>% 
        transmute("model" = "main temporal model",

        transmute("model" = "symptoms required with intctn",
               "intercept" = (b_Intercept), 
               "time coefficient" = (b_year_z),

        eapcXpertUsedDF0 %>%

               "intercept" = b_Intercept,

        eapcXpertUsedDF %>% 
        transmute("model" = "Xpert/Culture used with intctn",

allTemporalMods
```

### Model comparison 
#### Different covariate models 
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Each of these had a Pareto k sampling issues so use moment matching
looCauch <- loo(multiCauchyMod, moment_match = TRUE)
looCauch
looN10 <- loo(multiN10Mod, moment_match = TRUE)
looN10
looN1 <- loo(multiMod, moment_match = TRUE)
looN1

loo_compare(looCauch, looN1, looN10)
```
